verdict.rationale: Extend markets 'Agentic OCR' and accuracy on 'your hardest documents', and it detects tables, checkboxes, images and handwriting. One community user reports being happy with extraction accuracy over a year of use. However, nothing in the pack specifically covers scanned or photographed inputs, skew correction, stamps, or low-quality scans, so the core claim rests on marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed or rotated pages, stamp/seal recognition, low-quality or photographed scan robustness, independent hands-on OCR accuracy benchmarks.
